svg.title: Kneeboard plot mockup
svg.desc: Mockup (2026-10-28) of the planned kneeboard plot over a Bf 109 F-4 cockpit: a fixed sheet of the briefed route with pencil marks only for what the radio has said, each fading with age, beside the in-game radio chat. See docs/ROADMAP.md, "Kneeboard plot".

g.text: [12:38:10] [Lumme 1] [Viktor Richter]: Grid 1120-1, leg two of six.
[12:39:42] [Lumme 3] [Oliver Wollien]: Pair of Hurricanes, one o'clock, high,
Last fix 12:38, Lumme 1: grid 1120-1, leg two of six
Next waypoint 045, 6 km · Home Tusov 250, 19 km
Nothing here is live: each mark is a radio reply, and fades with age.
